transcript.text: Alright everyone, before we finalize the rollout plan for the new search-ranking model next week, I need to hear from each of the required teams. Search Platform, SRE, Customer Success, and Compliance — please report any relevant constraints or required follow-up commitments so we can make sure the checklist is satisfied. For reference, the current draft enables the model for 25% of all tenants on Monday at 09:00 UTC, keeps ranking-event logs for 30 days, applies the standard automated ranking behavior to every tenant, and has no special customer-notification step. Let's hear your concerns or approvals.

transcript.text: While testing tenant-specific analyzers yesterday, I confirmed that the new model is incompatible with the custom tokenization used by exactly three tenants: Lattice Health, Northwind Legal, and Solace Retail. Those tenants must be excluded from the first cohort. I haven't updated the rollout ticket yet because the compatibility test finished after the ticket's last review.
